$comment: The Trisagion in Classical Syriac (West Syriac use): the Qadishat, its short form, the Kurielaison that follows it in the Syriac liturgy (the Greek kept in Syriac letters, as the liturgical books keep it), and the Syriac doxology as a bundle-local gloriaPatri so the Byzantine form of this bundle never falls back to Latin mid-prayer. The Holy God and Glory Be were supplied by Erez for the Mission on 2026-08-26 as Aramaic in both Hebrew square script and pointed Syriac script; both were finally corrected on 2026-08-31. Their characters and line divisions are preserved exactly. The Kurielaison remains provisional standard Syriac Catholic wording until the Mission sends its own. The primary strings are Aramaic in Hebrew square script; the same Aramaic in Syriac letters is in transliterations, which is what the flow's script toggle shows.

prayers.trisagionAcclamation:
קַדּישַת אַלָהָא
קַדִישַת חַילתָּנָא
קַדִישַת לָא מִיותָּא אֶתַרחַמעלִין
prayers.gloriaPatri:
שוּבחָא לַאבָא ולַברָא וַלרוּחָא קַדישָא
מֶן עָלַם וַעדַמָא לעָלַם עָלמִין. אַמִין.
